description: Code for paper "The Markovian Thinker: Architecture-Agnostic Linear Scaling of Reasoning"

summary.one_liner: Research codebase for "The Markovian Thinker," an RL training method (Delethink) that chunks LLM reasoning into fixed-size segments so compute scales linearly with thinking length.
summary.what_it_does: The repository holds the training and tracing code for the Markovian Thinker paper. Delethink splits generation into fixed-size chunks, resetting the context at each boundary to the original question plus a short carryover, so the model learns to carry progress forward in text. The codebase is built on verl and SGLang and includes configs for DeepScaleR and OpenMath experiments at 24K and 96K response budgets, plus LongCoT-RL baselines at 8K and 24K. A single-file tracing demo runs Delethink inference on AIME 2024 with DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B. The README also describes a trajectory viewer script for inspecting LongCoT and Delethink rollouts.
use_cases: train reasoning LLMs with bounded context
run Delethink tracing on AIME math problems
compare LongCoT and Delethink training cost
how_to_run: Install following INSTALLATION.md (uv-based recipe or pre-built docker image)
notable: Delethink chunked reasoning: resets context to the question plus a short carryover at each boundary, keeping active context fixed (e.g., 8K)
Linear compute and flat memory with thinking length, per the paper's claim
Pre-trained Hugging Face models released for delethink-24k, delethink-96k, longcot-24k, and longcot-8k on 1.5B
Ready-made example scripts for reproducing paper RL experiments on 8xH100 nodes
caveats: Reproduction scripts are tested on a single 8xH100 GPU node; multi-node needs a separate template
Evaluation section is marked TBD in the README
Setup depends on verl and SGLang, so installation is nontrivial
keywords: reduce quadratic cost of long reasoning
train model to reason in chunks
